bayesian.note: Unchanged gate: rhat≤1.01, ESS≥400, divergences==0. Failed runs are preserved. Bayesian increment is not counted until those pass.

replication.note: Findings are exploratory. n_datasets=2 is the independent dataset replicate count. Training seeds also reshuffle target splits.

statistic.animal: SD of consecutive observed-visit log-weight increments (ddof=0)
statistic.not_done: between-draw study-effect variability is not mixed into the increment SD
statistic.reported_separately: E[study-level statistic] and between-draw SD of that statistic
statistic.simulated: each sample_study draw is one realized study; the same animal→study statistic is computed per draw
statistic.study: unweighted mean of animal increment SDs
